# Menu

Figma: [07n. Menu](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=3944-4150) · Family: 07 Cards & Lists · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

The complete menu family for Safqah - triggers, anchored/floating menus, selection menus, mobile sheet menus, and the command palette. Built reuse-first on IconButton, Button, Menu/MenuItem, Combobox, Tag, BottomSheet, FAB, Checkbox/Radio Indicator and Syntropy Icons. RTL-first (a single Direction variant per component). This page documents every component; each also lives as a labelled reference on the 07n page.

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/menu/reference.png`

### MenuItem

Action row of every menu: leading icon (or checkbox/radio indicator) and label, with optional submenu arrowhead and keyboard shortcut; destructive state in red.

Level: atom · Part of: Menu

Use when:
- Rows inside Menu, Dropdown menu, Action sheet, Command palette and other menu patterns
- Destructive actions fenced below a divider (State=destructive)

Don't use when:
- Persistent page rows: use ListItem
- Form field options: use Dropdown Item

Accessibility: role=menuitem (menuitemcheckbox/radio in selection menus); shortcut text stays LTR in its own node.

| Label | `label` | text |  | Menu item |

| Has submenu | `hasSubmenu` | boolean |  | false |

### Menu

Floating surface listing commands (Edit, Share, Delete) with section headers and a divider before the destructive action; the base every anchored menu reuses. Menus fire commands, they do not pick form values.

Level: organism · Contains: MenuItem, MenuSectionHeader, Divider · Part of: Dropdown menu, Cascading submenu

Use when:
- Overflow actions on a card, row or header
- Context actions grouped by section
- Base for building Dropdown menu, Sort menu and Filter menu

Don't use when:
- Picking a value for a form field: use Select or Multi-select field
- Free-form floating content (text, links, close): use Popover
- Persistent in-page rows: use ActionList
- Long menus on mobile: use Action sheet or Bottom-sheet menu

Accessibility: role=menu, arrow-key navigation, Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger, outside click dismisses.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | ltr, rtl | ltr |

### MenuTrigger

The button that opens a menu, in kebab, meatball, hamburger, bento, arrow or split glyphs; nests IconButton (split nests a Button plus an arrow IconButton).

Level: atom · Contains: IconButton, Button · Part of: Dropdown menu

Use when:
- Opening an overflow Menu on cards, rows or headers (Glyph=kebab / meatball)
- Split button with a primary action and more options (Glyph=split)

Don't use when:
- Expanding the navigation rail: use Icon / nav-toggle-menu
- Plain single actions: use IconButton or Button

Accessibility: aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded, and an aria-label such as More options.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Glyph | `glyph` | variant | kebab, meatball, hamburger, bento, arrow, split | kebab |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | ltr, rtl | ltr |

### Dropdown menu

MenuTrigger plus Menu anchored with a placement (bottom/top x start/end); also the preset for split-button, overflow and context menus.

Level: organism · Contains: MenuTrigger, Menu

Use when:
- Web and back-office overflow actions anchored to a button
- Header actions menus (export, share, settings)

Don't use when:
- Choosing a form value: use Select
- Mobile: use Action sheet
- Rich content panels: use Popover

Accessibility: Focus moves into the menu on open and back to the trigger on close; start/end flip in RTL.

| Placement | `placement` | variant | bottom-start, bottom-end, top-start, top-end | bottom-start |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | ltr, rtl | ltr |

### Cascading submenu

A child Menu flowing off a MenuItem with a submenu arrowhead, opening toward the end or start edge.

Level: organism · Contains: Menu, MenuItem

Use when:

Don't use when:
- Mobile: flatten into a Bottom-sheet menu

Accessibility: Right/left arrow (mirrored in RTL) opens and closes the submenu; aria-haspopup on the parent item.

### Multi-select field

Form field that holds several selected values shown as chips, a count or text, paired with a checkbox menu with select-all and clear-all.

Level: organism · Contains: Tag, MenuItem, Checkbox Indicator

Use when:
- Choosing several values in a back-office form or filter (regions, asset types)

Don't use when:
- A single value: use Select or Combobox Field
- Few options visible on the page: use Checkbox Group or SelectionList (Mode=Multi)

Accessibility: Field has a visible label; chips removable by keyboard; selected count announced.

### Action sheet

Mobile bottom-anchored list of actions with a destructive option and Cancel; the phone form of a Menu.

Level: organism · Contains: MenuItem, Button

Use when:
- Overflow actions on mobile (share deal, cancel reservation)
- Confirming a destructive choice among a few actions

Don't use when:
- Desktop: use Dropdown menu
- Tasks with content or inputs: use BottomSheet

Accessibility: Modal dialog semantics; Cancel always present and focusable; destructive action labelled clearly.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

A menu presents a list of actions or options anchored to a trigger. This system spans five tracks: A · Triggers, B · Anchored / floating, C · Selection (form-integrated), D · Mobile sheet-based, and E · Command. All share the same surface, MenuItem row, section header and divider, so every menu feels like one family.

> **Info:** Reuse-first: no base component was rebuilt. Where a piece was missing (MenuTrigger, MenuItem), it was added as an atom; the rest compose existing sets. Popover “menu”, pickers and navigation were scoped out.

### When to use

Menus fire commands or carry a selection, anchored to a trigger and dismissed on outside-click. Reach for a neighbour when the job is different:

- Menu - runs commands (Edit, Share, Delete) from a trigger. Floating, transient.
- Select / Multi-select - picks a value for a form field, not a command.
- ActionList (07f) - a persistent list of rows inside the page (settings), not a floating overlay.
- Popover (05i) - a free-form content panel; Menu is its list-of-actions specialisation.
- On mobile - a long menu becomes a Bottom sheet / Action sheet (Track D), not a tiny floating list.

### Atomic architecture

### Atoms

- MenuTrigger - the button that opens a menu (kebab · meatball · hamburger · bento · arrow · split).
- MenuItem - an action row: leading icon (or checkbox/radio) + label, optional submenu arrowhead & shortcut. States default · hover · disabled · destructive.
- MenuSectionHeader - a muted label titling a group of items.

### Subsection

- Menu surface, Divider, IconButton, Button, Combobox, Tag, BottomSheet, FAB, Checkbox/Radio Indicator, Syntropy Icons.

### A · MenuTrigger

One set for every trigger glyph. Nests IconButton, so Size / State / Icon are inherited (open = the pressed look); the split glyph nests a Button primary-action slot + an arrow IconButton. VARIANT: Glyph × Direction.

### Atom · MenuItem

The action row. VARIANT: State × Direction. Props: Label (text) · Icon (swap - also accepts a Checkbox / Radio Indicator for selection menus) · Has submenu (trailing arrowhead) · Has shortcut + Shortcut (text).

### MenuSectionHeader & Menu

MenuSectionHeader titles a group. Menu is the surface that composes header + items + a divider before the destructive action - the base every anchored menu reuses.

### B · Anchored / floating menus

Menus that open next to a trigger. Dropdown menu = MenuTrigger + Menu with placement; Cascading submenu flows a child menu off a submenu item; Split-button, Overflow and Context are Dropdown-menu presets (trigger / density / origin).

- Dropdown menu - VARIANT placement (bottom/top × start/end) × Direction.
- Cascading submenu - VARIANT open-direction (end/start) × Direction; uses MenuItem’s submenu arrowhead.
- Presets - Split-button (glyph=split) · Overflow (+density) · Context (+origin pointer/touch).

### C · Selection menus

Form-integrated menus that carry state. Sort (radio + asc/desc), Filter (checkbox + Apply/Clear), Multi-select field (chips / count / text via Tag), Autocomplete (Combobox + highlight-match + loading).

- Sort - radio MenuItems + VARIANT order (asc/desc).
- Filter - checkbox MenuItems + Apply / Clear footer (Button).
- Multi-select field - VARIANT value-display (chips/count/text); chips = Tag; pair with a checkbox menu + select-all / clear-all.
- Autocomplete - Combobox field + suggestions with highlight-match; VARIANT loading (idle/loading).

### D · Mobile - sheet-based

On phones a menu becomes a bottom sheet / action sheet - a bottom-anchored surface (grabber, rounded top) with a prominent tappable action list. Reuses the BottomSheet surface, MenuItem, Button and FAB.

- Action sheet - MenuItem actions + destructive + Cancel.
- Bottom-sheet menu - section + MenuItem list + grabber.
- FAB speed-dial - VARIANT collapsed / expanded (FAB + labelled action rows).
- Long-press preview - a content preview card + contextual action list.

### E · Command palette

A ⌘K search over commands: a Combobox field header + grouped MenuSectionHeader + MenuItem results. VARIANT state (results / no-results; also empty / searching).

### Direction - RTL / Arabic-first

RTL is primary. Every component carries a single Direction = LTR | RTL variant (our convention) - no separate mirrored set.

- Leading = start, trailing = end: icons lead on the reading-start side, submenu arrowheads and dropdown anchors point to the end and flip in RTL.
- Structural flips are the Direction variant’s job: submenu open-direction, sheet/drawer entry edge, dropdown anchor edge, directional arrowheads.
- Keyboard-shortcut text stays LTR in its own node.

### Code example

```typescript
<Menu dir="rtl" trigger={<MenuTrigger glyph="kebab" />}>
  <Menu.Section title="الإجراءات">
    <Menu.Item icon="edit">تعديل</Menu.Item>
    <Menu.Item icon="share" submenu>مشاركة</Menu.Item>
  </Menu.Section>
  <Menu.Divider />
  <Menu.Item icon="trash" destructive>حذف</Menu.Item>
</Menu>
```

### Usage - Do and Don't

Do

Group related actions, title groups with a section header, and fence the destructive action below a divider.

Don’t

Don’t use a Menu to pick a form value - that’s Select/Multi-select. Menus fire commands; on mobile, use a sheet.

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Info:** Everything reuses existing sets - MenuTrigger and MenuItem are the only new atoms; the rest compose Menu, Combobox, BottomSheet, FAB, Tag, Button, Checkbox/Radio Indicator and Syntropy Icons.

> **Tip:** Arrowheads (submenu, dropdown, split, sort order) use Icon/Arrow-right 3 rotated - arrowhead only, no shaft, per the brand call.

> **Warning:** On mobile a long menu should become a bottom sheet / action sheet - don’t cram many rows into a floating list. Autocomplete’s loading row still needs a live Spinner swapped in.
